reason: A WebUI customization plugin that provides a settings page for editing, importing, synchronizing, and injecting custom CSS and background images across connected browsers.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH WebUI 提供自定义 CSS 编辑、导入、持久化同步和背景图注入功能，以调整界面主题与视觉样式。
summaries.en: Customizes the DSH WebUI with an editor for CSS and background images, supporting persistence, synchronization, and style injection across connected browsers.

capabilities: Injects user-provided CSS into the WebUI
Persists shared CSS settings for connected browsers
Imports CSS files and embeds uploaded background images as data URIs
Reads and writes plugin settings through trusted-host RPC channels
Stores unsaved drafts in browser localStorage
